episodes.name: Local-only embedding decision
episodes.content: WebHound uses all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (local) for dense embeddings. Cloud embedding APIs are explicitly prohibited to protect potentially sensitive page content and eliminate API costs.

episodes.name: DalFox confirms XSS active
episodes.content: DalFox is used as the active XSS confirmation engine. When DalFox fires, WADE increases confidence score by +0.4 (active confirmation weight). False positive rate is low for reflected XSS.

episodes.name: Cloudflare 1020 is not a finding
episodes.content: HTTP 1020 from Cloudflare is an access denied / WAF block page, not a vulnerability. WADE suppresses findings on 1020 responses to prevent false XSS/injection alerts on WAF-managed error pages.

episodes.name: Vercel deployment protection gate
episodes.content: Vercel preview deployments may have deployment protection enabled. Scanners receive 401 or redirect to auth gate instead of the actual app. WADE should not flag auth-gated responses as vulnerabilities.

episodes.name: GreyNoise classifies CDN IPs as benign
episodes.content: Shared CDN IP addresses (Cloudflare, Fastly, Akamai) appear in GreyNoise as scanners or benign mass-event IPs. WADE should not flag a CDN IP as malicious based solely on GreyNoise classification.

episodes.name: XSS maps to CWE-79
episodes.content: All cross-site scripting findings (reflected, stored, DOM-based) are classified as CWE-79. Severity is assigned per CVSS v3.1 based on exploitability and impact subscores.

episodes.name: WADE confidence threshold for reporting
episodes.content: WADE only reports findings with confidence >= 0.4. Findings below this threshold are suppressed as likely false positives. Active confirmation (DalFox) raises confidence above threshold in most cases.

episodes.name: Hybrid retrieval weight choice (0.35/0.65)
episodes.content: Hybrid retrieval uses 0.35 lexical + 0.65 dense weight. Phase 7A evaluation: dense_only 71%/84%/92% vs hybrid 76%/88%/90% top-1/3/5. Dense weight higher because semantic similarity outperforms keyword on 120-Q benchmark.

episodes.name: Phase 7A hybrid retrieval benchmark

episodes.name: CDN shared IPs suppress TI alerts
episodes.content: Cloudflare, Fastly, Akamai IPs appear in AbuseIPDB/GreyNoise as benign mass-event scanners. WADE suppresses threat_intel_match for well-known CDN CIDR ranges to prevent customer-facing false positives on shared infrastructure.

episodes.name: Lexical fallback when dense unavailable
episodes.content: WADE retrieval falls back to lexical_only mode when sentence_transformers or numpy is absent (CI environment). Hybrid mode (0.35 lexical + 0.65 dense) is used when the 384-dim MiniLM index is available.
